'''Saber Team''' was a legendary [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] unit founded by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gideon Argus/Legends|Gideon Argus]]. After a botched operation led to accusations of treachery, Argus left the squad.<ref name="SWIA">{{SWIA|set=Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set|text=Core Set}}</ref>
